glossary.title: Tabla de posiciones
glossary.intro: Datos de MLB StatsAPI. Con juegos en vivo la tabla se renueva cada minuto.

streak.name: Ganados o perdidos seguidos
streak.description: G3: ganó los últimos 3. P1: perdió el último.

last10.name: Últimos 10 juegos
last10.description: Del más reciente al más viejo: punto verde ganó, rojo perdió; punteado, por jugar.

expected.name: Récord esperado
expected.description: El récord que le tocaría por sus carreras anotadas y permitidas, según MLB.

luck.name: Ganados de más o de menos
luck.description: Positivo: ha ganado más de lo que dicen sus carreras.

homeAway.name: Récord en casa y de visita

dayNight.name: Récord de día y de noche

leftRight.name: Contra abridor zurdo o derecho
leftRight.description: Según la mano del lanzador abridor del rival.

oneRunExtra.name: Juegos de una carrera · entradas extra

elimination.name: Número de eliminación
elimination.description: Triunfos del último que clasifica o derrotas propias que faltan para quedar fuera.

clinched.name: Lugar asegurado
clinched.description: Pasa aunque pierda todo lo que le falta.

eliminated.name: Fuera de la clasificación
eliminated.description: Ya no puede alcanzar la línea de corte.

h2h.title: Enfrentamientos directos
h2h.lead: Récord de la fila contra la columna. Si no se han visto, el día del próximo duelo.
h2h.caption: Récord de cada equipo (fila) contra cada rival (columna)
h2h.cellPending: {{team}} contra {{rival}}: sin jugar, próximo duelo el {{day}}
h2h.allMet: Las {{count}} parejas ya se vieron al menos una vez.
h2h.pendingBy: Del {{from}} al {{to}} se cruzan las {{count}} parejas al menos una vez.

es.calendarMissing: La carrera, los enfrentamientos directos y la fecha en cifras salen cuando el servidor manda el calendario de la temporada.

race.title: Playoff race
race.leadRegular: Games over .500 after each date. The top {{count}} advance to the Round Robin: the blue band is the cut line.
race.leadRoundRobin: Games over .500 after each Round Robin date. The top {{count}} reach the final: the blue band is the cut line.
race.favorite: Your team has the thicker line.
race.hint: Tap a team to isolate its line
race.aria: Playoff race: each team's games over .500 after each date. Now: {{summary}}.
race.early_one: The season just started: {{count}} date played. The chart grows with every game day.
race.early_other: The season just started: {{count}} dates played. The chart grows with every game day.
race.chartHint: Tap the chart near a line, or a team below, to isolate it.

table.title: Table
table.caption: Standings, {{phase}}
table.noteFavorite: Your team is highlighted in gold.
table.noteCut: Above the cut line, the teams that qualify today.
table.noteRuns: The Runs view highlights DIFF without changing the table order. Luck: wins above (+) or below (−) MLB's expected record.
table.noteSorted: Sorted by {{name}}: the cut line is hidden and the small box is still the standings place. Tap the column again to go back.
table.situationsEmpty: No split has games yet (home, road, day, night…). The map fills in with the first games of the phase.

glossary.title: Standings
glossary.intro: Data from MLB StatsAPI. With games in progress the table refreshes every minute.

streak.name: Wins or losses in a row
streak.description: W3: won the last 3. L1: lost the last one.

last10.name: Last 10 games
last10.description: Most recent first: green dot won, red lost; dashed, still to play.

expected.name: Expected record
expected.description: The record its runs scored and allowed point to, according to MLB.

luck.name: Wins above or below expected
luck.description: Positive: it has won more than its runs suggest.

leftRight.name: Against left- or right-handed starters
leftRight.description: By the throwing hand of the opposing starter.

elimination.name: Elimination number
elimination.description: Wins by the last qualifying team or own losses left before being knocked out.

clinched.name: Spot secured
clinched.description: Advances even if it loses every remaining game.

eliminated.name: Out of the race
eliminated.description: Can no longer reach the cut line.

h2h.title: Head to head
h2h.lead: Row team's record against the column team. If they haven't met, the day of their next game.
h2h.caption: Each team's record (row) against each opponent (column)
h2h.cellPending: {{team}} vs {{rival}}: not played yet, next meeting {{day}}
h2h.allMet: All {{count}} pairs have met at least once.
h2h.pendingBy: Between {{from}} and {{to}} all {{count}} pairs meet at least once.

en.calendarMissing: The race, head-to-head and date numbers show up once the server sends the season schedule.
